title: Open Logic Project — Edisi Lengkap Bahasa Indonesia / Complete Indonesian Edition (OLP-0722, 722/722)
description:
Download the complete 1,116-page Indonesian reader / Unduh pembaca lengkap Bahasa Indonesia.

Edisi lengkap Bahasa Indonesia / Complete Indonesian edition: all 722/722 frozen Open Logic Project content modules are translated. This edition IsTranslationOf the English Open Logic Project at commit 9620cc73f9c8e0ad003c514a5d3748f29611c4c0, tree f67757bb9305b173634082ab4cefd5601a707a34, under CC BY 4.0. The reader covers 642 canonical-reader-reachable modules; 80 retained non-reader modules remain in the editable corpus and are explicitly outside build/render applicability.

All 722 targets passed exact existence and hash replay, and the complete reader passed a source-frozen build, text-layer checks, and visual inspection of all pages. The toolchain package graph is not fully pinned, so byte-identical rebuilds on every machine are not claimed. The evidence package retains consolidated independent batch-review receipts through OLP-0321; the later 401 units are not represented as having equivalent retained independent receipts. Editable sources and evidence preserve terminology, decisions, source-backed emendations, build/render receipts, hashes, closure records, and adverse evidence.

Exact release DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21932787. Stable Indonesian concept DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21932786. Repository and matching release: KokunoYumeto/OpenLogic-id.

Performed at the direction of Floris by OpenAI 5.6 Sol, Ultra mode (OpenAI's current flagship model for complex work). No Open Logic Project endorsement is implied.
